# Backend Coders India

> Backend Coders India is a custom software engineering, website development, and digital marketing company based in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India. Founded by Ravindra Verma, the agency delivers bespoke Laravel web applications, native and cross-platform mobile apps, modular ERP/POS systems, SaaS platforms, and search engine optimization (SEO) services for Indian small-to-medium businesses, startups, and international clients.

## Business Identity & Contact Details

- **Company Name:** Backend Coders India (also known as Backend Coders)
- **Founder & CEO:** Ravindra Verma
- **Headquarters:** 11/42, Krishna Nagar, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208007, India
- **Coordinates:** 26.4204° N, 80.3723° E
- **Official Website:** https://backendcodersindia.com/
- **Primary Telephone:** +91 9140092133 / +91 914 0092 133
- **Primary Email:** info@backendcodersindia.com
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Saturday: 09:30 AM – 06:30 PM IST (Sunday Closed)
- **Primary Service Regions:** Kanpur Nagar, Lucknow, Noida, Delhi NCR, and remote clients across India and globally.

## Published Starting Prices & Deliverables

- **Website Development:** Packages start at ₹7,999 (one-time) for Starter Business Landing Page; ₹15,999 for Growth Multi-Page Website; ₹24,999+ for Advanced Custom Dynamic Portals.
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO):** Monthly retainers start at ₹7,999/month (local Kanpur business visibility, on-page optimization, technical audits, citation building).
- **Digital Marketing & PPC:** Monthly packages start at ₹6,999/month (Google Ads, Meta Ads campaign setup, conversion tracking, monthly reporting).
- **Custom SaaS & ERP/POS:** Custom software implementations start from ₹39,999 (modular inventory control, GST invoice generation, role-based access control, offline resilience).
- **Mobile Application Development:** Android and cross-platform mobile applications start from ₹19,999.
- **Website Maintenance & Support:** Monthly retainer plans start at ₹2,999/month.

## Canonical Service Pages

- [Website Design & Development](https://backendcodersindia.com/page/website-design-development): Custom responsive websites, landing pages, enterprise web portals, and CMS solutions engineered with clean Laravel and modern frontend architecture.
- [Mobile App Development](https://backendcodersindia.com/page/mobile-app-development): High-performance native Android, iOS, and Flutter/React Native mobile applications with secure backend APIs.
- [ERP & POS Software Development](https://backendcodersindia.com/page/erp-pos-software): Custom enterprise resource planning and point-of-sale software engineered for Kanpur manufacturers, retail chains, and distributors with inventory control and GST billing.
- [SaaS Application Development](https://backendcodersindia.com/page/saas-development): End-to-end SaaS engineering, multi-tenant cloud architectures, subscription billing, and automated customer onboarding.
- [Custom E-Commerce Development](https://backendcodersindia.com/page/ecommerce-development): Scalable online storefronts, custom shopping carts, payment gateway integration (Razorpay, Stripe), and inventory management.
- [Custom Web Application Development](https://backendcodersindia.com/page/custom-web-applications): Enterprise web apps, secure client dashboards, and database-driven software built on Laravel and modern JavaScript.
- [Startup MVP Development](https://backendcodersindia.com/page/startup-mvp-development): Rapid prototype engineering and lean product builds for early-stage founders to validate product-market fit.
- [API Development & Integration](https://backendcodersindia.com/page/api-development): Secure RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, third-party webhook integrations, and microservices.
- [SEO Services in Kanpur](https://backendcodersindia.com/seo): Technical site audits, on-page optimization, helpful content strategy, and white-hat authority building starting from ₹7,999/month.
- [Local SEO Services](https://backendcodersindia.com/page/local-seo): Google Business Profile optimization, localized Kanpur citation building, and Google Maps local 3-pack visibility.
- [Digital Marketing Agency in Kanpur](https://backendcodersindia.com/digital-marketing-agency-kanpur): Full-funnel digital marketing combining organic search, Google Ads PPC, and social media advertising.
- [Software Company in Kanpur](https://backendcodersindia.com/software-company-kanpur): Custom business software development, database design, and workflow automation for regional enterprises.

## Featured Real-World Projects & Case Studies

- [Agency Lead Generation & SEO Workflow Software](https://backendcodersindia.com/project/seo-audit-lead-generation-and-agency-workflow-software): Automated audit tool, prospect pipeline tracker, and client reporting dashboard for agency operations.
- [Marley Moves Logistics & Transport Platform](https://backendcodersindia.com/project/marley-moves-logistics-transport-platform): Freight management, vehicle routing, dispatch coordination, and real-time tracking software.
- [Pulse Events Management & Ticketing Portal](https://backendcodersindia.com/project/pulse-events-management-ticketing-portal): Event ticketing system, QR-code check-in verification, and seat reservation engine.

## Technical Standards & Intellectual Property

- **Architecture:** Clean Laravel backend engineering, normalized MySQL/PostgreSQL relational schemas, Tailwind CSS responsive layouts, and RESTful APIs.
- **Security:** CSRF protection, parameter binding against SQL injection, strict session management, HTTPS/SSL enforcement, and zero plain-text credential storage.
- **Code Ownership:** Clients receive 100% ownership of source code, Git repositories, and documentation upon project handover with zero recurring vendor lock-in fees.
